snippet.title: Raghee Horner
snippet.description:
Watch. Learn. Practice. Repeat.

What if trading could feel simpler, not because the markets are simple, but because you have a process for knowing what to look for, how to prepare, and what to do next? How to look at the market differently. 

With 38 years of trading experience, Raghee Horner has developed a practical approach to trading stocks, ETFs, options, futures, and indices. She shares the market insights, strategies, tools, and frameworks she uses to help traders see the market differently and trade with greater clarity, confidence, and control.

You'll learn how to:

• Find potential symbols and setups
• Understand sectors, trends, momentum, and price action
• Build a game plan before entering a trade
• Identify entries, exits, targets, and risk
• Use technical tools with purpose
• Develop discipline and a repeatable trading process

Subscribe and learn how Raghee approaches the markets.

snippet.title: Trade with Pat
snippet.description:
I'm Pat, and this is Trade with Pat. This channel is dedicated to everything day trading. I share my strategies, tips, robots, signals and indicators in order to help you become more consistent trader. My videos cover Forex, gold and indices. While I'm still relatively new to the YouTube game, I've been in the Forex market for over 17 years running my blog, Forex Robot Nation.

I'm working on becoming a better teacher every day, so I hope that my tutorials and trade approach can help you achieve your goals.

Nothing on this channel is financial advice, they are simply my opinions. Education and entertainment only.
